CoinJoin update: supports Kilojoin v5 alongside v3/v4, shows closing-vote acknowledgement and phase progress/deadlines, and refreshes pending confirmation when reopening the screen or returning to the foreground. Includes recovery for newer creator closing messages while waiting for a blind signature. Transaction signing and fee checks remain explicit. Background reconnection and recovery after an app restart are not guaranteed. Change remains separately labelled and frozen to prevent accidental recombination. Experimental: test carefully.
